title: Father Marquess-Barry Apartments
address:
301 NW 17th St
Miami, Florida 33136
United States
description:
Father Marquess-Barry Apartments is a 60-unit affordable and workforce housing community for seniors 62 and older in Miami's historic Overtown neighborhood. The three-story Bahamian-style building, designed by Modis Architects, holds 48 one-bedroom and 12 two-bedroom units ranging from about 684 to 969 square feet, each with its own washer and dryer, Energy Star appliances, and granite countertops.

Residents share a multipurpose club room, a fitness center, a library and media center with computers, secure package lockers, and bike racks, along with free on-site health and lifestyle programs.
